name: Narayan Sahoo

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Narayan Sahoo writes poetry in Odia. His Kabita Live poem ‘ଛାରପୋକ’ turns the bedbug into an unsettling measure of human conduct. Beginning with images of blood and hunger, it widens into a critique of greed, violence and the desire to rule over others.

The poem’s force comes from a reversal: the creature people despise becomes a witness against human cruelty. Images of caged birds and destructive weapons extend its concern beyond an individual quarrel, while its closing comparison asks what limits people recognise in the pursuit of power.
